messages.content: Hi! I'm looking at my current schema and thinking about making some improvements. Can you help me understand what might be enhanced?

function.name: propose_schema
function.description: Submit a concrete schema proposal with both JSON schema object and cookbook content. BOTH parameters are required.

schema_json.description: The complete JSON schema definition as an object (not string). Must include 'type', 'properties', etc.

cookbook_content.description: The interpretation cookbook content in markdown format with examples
